Job description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Semantic Data Modeler to join our data and AI team. This role will focus on designing and implementing canonical models, ontologies, and taxonomies to enable a unified semantic layer that bridges structured data from multiple silos (RDBMS and other sources) into AI-ready, knowledge-driven assets. The ideal candidate will bring expertise in both traditional data modeling (SQL, ER modeling) and semantic/knowledge representation (ontologies, RDF, OWL, SKOS), along with hands-on experience in leading ontology and taxonomy management tools.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain ontologies, taxonomies, and knowledge graphs to support enterprise-wide semantic data integration.
Build a semantic abstraction layer that maps and harmonizes relational data (SQL/RDBMS) into AI-ready semantic structures.
Define and govern canonical data vocabularies across domains to ensure consistency, interoperability, and reuse.
Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to model concepts that align with business needs and AI/ML initiatives.
Leverage ontology and taxonomy management tools (e.g., TopBraid Composer, PoolParty, Protg, VocBench) for design, validation, and publishing.
Develop mapping strategies from ER models/logical data models to RDF/OWL-based ontologies leveraging Linked Data Modelling Language.
Ensure models adhere to semantic standards (RDF, OWL, SKOS, SHACL, SPARQL) and align with Unified enterprise architecture principles.
Support data cataloging, metadata enrichment, and semantic search through ontology-driven approaches.
Contribute to the organization’s strategy of “model once, leverage everywhere” for data standardization and AI readiness.
Experience & Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Science or related field.
5-8 Years of total experience in data modeling or information architecture or Data engineering.

description:
This Position reports to:
Accounting & Reporting Manager - Account
Your responsibilities
Credit Assessment and Risk Analysis : You will be responsible for evaluating the creditworthiness of customers and assessing their ability to repay their debts. Credit Policy Development and Implement : You will be responsible to develop and implement credit policies and procedures that align with the company's overall financial goals and objectives (in line with ABB Group Credit Policy). This includes establishing guidelines for credit limits, payment terms, credit terms, and credit terms negotiation.
Business Relationship Management : You will be closely working with ABBs Collection Team and ABBs various Business units to build strong relationships and resolve any credit-related issues. This includes sending reminders, making collection calls, and coordinating ABBs Collection Team and various Business units, if necessary. Financial Reporting and Analysis : You will be responsible to generate regular reports on credit-related metrics such as accounts receivable aging, bad debt provisions, and collection efficiency. These reports help management assess the overall credit risk and make informed decisions.
Perform annual review of all Customers : You will be responsible for review of all Customer accounts and set-up revised Credit Limit, Risk Category, Credit Check rules etc. Living ABB s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues.

0 - 2 years of experience in Credit management in any manufacturing company.

Firm Risk Management
Firm Risk Management (FRM) supports Morgan Stanley to achieve its business goals by partnering with business units across the Firm to realize efficient risk-adjusted returns, acting as a strategic advisor to the Board and protecting the Firm from exposure to losses as a result of credit, market, liquidity, operational, model and other risks.

Background on the Position
The role will reside within the Morgan Stanley Risk Data team within the Firm Risk Management Division. Risk Data is responsible for the development data standards for FRM, governance, and monitoring of the Risk Domains to evidence compliance with The Global Data Quality Policy and the BCBS 239 Principles. Risk Data team provides strategic partnership across Firm Risk to enhance Risk Data management. The team is responsible for creating and maintaining the Global Risk Data Policy, and for reviewing proposed country, legal entity or risk domain specific Risk Data policies or procedures to ensure congruency and alignment across FRM.
Risk Data seeks an Analyst/Associate for a Mumbai-based Risk Data Office role. The selected candidate will be part of a team focused on partnering with Risk Domains to develop and drive strategic solutions for process efficiency and data management challenges across Firm Risk. The team's remit also includes initiatives related to the Firm's overall compliance with RDA principles as well as Risk Data Domain compliance with the Risk Data Policy.

1. Contribute towards execution of prioritized data initiatives in compliance with the Global Data Policy and BCBS239 requirements across FRM
2. Governing and advising risk coverage teams to identify and document risk data ownership, authority, sourcing, controls and quality; Develop and implement ongoing update, review and control for prioritized risk data
3. Identifying and executing and work on areas for improvement in processes related to risk data management
4. Liaising with data quality working groups across the Firm on pertinent issues
5. Contribute towards data issue management for Firm Risk Management, manage data issues through their full life cycle, from reviewing and logging, to remediation.
6. Conduct analysis on large data sets and technology systems to identify the root cause of the risk data quality issues. Perform impact analysis where required.

Experience, Qualifications

2. 2-3 years of work experience in the financial services industry preferably in risk management, finance, operation or equivalent experience

Job Title: Team Lead Analytics and Data Science
Department: Analytics and Data Science (ADS)
Location: Chennai, Bangalore & Noida preferred
Collaborative teams: Organization-wide

Oh, the things youll do:

We predict credit risk and other key metrics using machine learning (ML) models – this will be one of your key tasks, where you will build these and work with stakeholders to implement them in a timely and accurate manner
You will also work on other underwriting rules and optimize them
Once these are implemented, you will help monitor the portfolio and suggest corrections where necessary
You will evaluate other data sources to improve these models
We do not just work on underwriting – the team provides analytics support across the organization, and you will be involved in this work
You will run controlled tests based on Design of Experiments principle to add value to the business – this involves critical thinking
You will mentor junior members and help them grow

What you need to bring to the table-

You should have built machine learning models and have good knowledge of statistics
You should have good understanding of the underlying details about how the machine learning models work
We expect you to have the ability to work independently on projects end-to-end starting with formulating problem statements, identifying solutions to the problems, breaking the solution into smaller tasks, and do hands on analysis of data to arrive at the solution
We need someone who has programmed before – in R or Python or SQL etc.  If you can program well in any language, we feel you can pick up another easily. 
Are you a critical thinker with good problem solving skills?  We do not just build ML models using pre-packaged tools – that is a good skill to have but does not make you a rounded data scientist.  In your job, you may just be asked a high level, poorly defined question – your job will involve understanding context, bounding the problem, forming hypotheses and delving into the data and coming up with a solution.  Have you done that?  Are you confident of doing that?
Can you understand your problem well enough that you can convey the key message to a lay person through presentations and other means?

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Product Designer to join the Library team, building the vision of sales response management for Loopio s customers. This role focuses on streamlining our customer s workflows by organizing enterprise knowledge, providing instant access to trusted content, and generating highly contextual, personalized proposals with confidence and efficiency.

You will partner closely with other designers, Product Managers, Researchers, Software Developers, ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and other business stakeholders across customer and go-to-market teams to help us take Loopio s AI features to the next level.
  Note that this role requires close collaboration with teams across Canada, the UK, and India. To accommodate the time zone differences, you will be expected to work from 11 am - 7:30 pm IST.

What you'll Be Doing
Be deeply involved in all aspects of product development; work collaboratively with Product and Engineering from Ideation, validation through implementation
Work with the Product Team to collect and synthesize customer feedback, explore ideas and customer value validation
Study and solve complex user problems by exploring a wide breadth of ideas and converging on solutions using a strategic blend of user research, data, peer feedback, and professional intuition
Design and confidently conduct UX research using a thoughtful blend of generative and evaluative mixed methods
Extensive interaction design; you will create prototypes and think through complex workflows
Leverage user data from digital experience analytic tools to inform your designs
Track and own the performance of your designs post-launch
Partner with our Engineering team to incorporate feedback and technical considerations into your designs
Facilitate design critiques, empathy building and ideation activities with your team
Lead design discussions with your Agile team, design peers, other Loopers, and customers to effectively solve user problems with solutions that are innovative, effective, and technically feasible
Contribute to and maintain our design system and design principles
Provide coaching and mentoring to junior designers in design best practices
Help advocate for design thinking throughout the entire organization, shaping and living our design culture at Loopio
What you'll Bring to the Team
5+ years work experience in Product Design (B2B company experience is a plus)
Highly proficient with interaction design and experience tackling complex workflows
Experience with design thinking and user-centric design
Strong visual design skills; you know how to apply concepts of space, layout, visual hierarchy and affordance to user interface design. You are opinionated about typography and iconography and are comfortable with their nuances
Strong communication skills; you can clearly articulate the rationale behind your design decisions, and express complex ideas and concepts with simplicity
Comfortable communicating ideas and exploring problems visually; whiteboarding and sketching
Strong strategy skills; you can advocate for the customer while ensuring business value
Focused on user outcomes; you can tie your designs decisions to user value and goals
Meeting and workshop facilitation skills; to ensure everyone on your team understands the full understanding of a problem, opportunity or solution
Curiosity & growth mindset; you humbly see constructive feedback as a gift and an opportunity to grow.
Where you'll Work
Loopio is a global company, HQ d in Canada, that embraces flexible and effective work models. While many of our teams operate remotely, this role is part of a new, strategic product team that will work in a hybrid model to accelerate innovation and foster deep collaboration.
For this role, you will be based in our Ahmedabad, Gujarat hub, with the expectation of working from our co-working space in downtown Ahmedabad 3 days per week . This approach is intentionally designed to give you the best of both worlds: high-impact, in-person collaboration with your team to drive impactful product initiatives, and the flexibility of focused work-from-home days.
Our employees (or Loopers, as we call ourselves!) live and work in Canada (British Columbia and Ontario), London, and India (specifically in Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Bengaluru).
Our India/UK hub employees work according to business hours stated in the job description above. This is intentionally designed to enable our global teams to have overlapping hours for collaboration.
you'll collaborate with your immediate team in person and with our global teams virtually across the UK, Canada, and the US (we're just a Zoom call and Slack message away!), with core sync hours and focus time for headsdown work during the workday
We encourage balancing synchronous and asynchronous collaboration to effectively work as a global #OneTeam!
Why you'll Working at Loopio
Your manager supports your development by providing ongoing feedback and regular 1-on-1s, we leverage Lattice for our 1:1s and performance conversations
You will have the opportunity to elevate your craft and the opportunity to explore your creativity, with a dedicated professional mastery allowance for more learning support! We encourage experimentation and innovative thinking to drive business impact.

you'll be joining a supportive culture that offers the best of both worlds: deep connections built in a collaborative office environment and the flexibility of a global, virtual-first company.
Enjoy the camaraderie and energy of a dedicated office space, complete with snacks, beverages, and amenities to fuel your day. Your team will also have a dedicated social budget for welcome lunches and other activities
Participate in townhalls, AMA (Ask-Me-Anything), and quarterly celebrations to celebrate the big wins and milestones as #oneteam!
Our four active Employee Resource Groups offer opportunities for employees to learn and connect year-round.

description:

Incident Response: Lead the response to data-related security incidents, including breaches of personal data, ensuring that all relevant parties are notified as per legal requirements.
Forensics: Work closely with the incident response team to investigate security breaches, assess the scope of impact, and implement corrective actions.
Collaboration with IT and Legal Teams: Collaborate with IT, legal, and compliance teams to handle data-related incidents, ensuring compliance with notification timelines and documenting the incident appropriately.
3. Data Protection Strategy & Security Measures:
Data Encryption: Ensure that sensitive data is protected through encryption, both at rest and in transit.
Data Loss Prevention (DLP): Implement and manage DLP tools to monitor, detect, and prevent unauthorized data transfers or leaks.
Access Controls: Work with the IT department to implement and enforce robust access control policies to limit access to personal data based on the principle of least privilege.
Backup and Recovery: Ensure data is adequately backed up, and there is a clear strategy for recovery in case of data loss or breach.
4. Policy Development and Implementation:
Policy Creation: Develop and maintain comprehensive data protection policies, including those related to data retention, handling, and destruction.
Security Controls: Assist in the design and implementation of security controls to safeguard sensitive and personal data, ensuring proper segregation and protection.
Vendor Management: Work with third-party vendors to ensure that they meet data protection and security standards, especially if they handle personal data.
5. Reporting & Documentation:
Reporting: Regularly report to senior management and compliance teams on data protection and security status, including ongoing incidents, DSR request processing, and compliance audits.
Documentation: Maintain detailed records of DSR requests, security incidents, and compliance audits to support audits and regulatory requirements.

description:

We are seeking an experienced NLP & LLM Specialist to join our team.

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in working with transformer-based models, including GPT, BERT, T5, RoBERTa, and similar models.

This role requires experience in fine-tuning these pre-trained models on domain-specific tasks, as well as crafting and optimizing prompts for natural language processing tasks such as text generation, summarization, question answering, classification, and translation.

The candidate should be proficient in Python and familiar with NLP libraries like Hugging Face, SpaCy, and NLTK, with a solid understanding of model evaluation metrics.

Roles and Responsibilities :

- Model Expertise : Work with transformer models such as GPT, BERT, T5, RoBERTa, and others for a variety of NLP tasks, including text generation, summarization, classification, and translation.

- Model Fine-Tuning : Fine-tune pre-trained models on domain-specific datasets to improve performance for specific applications such as summarization, text generation, and question answering.

- Prompt Engineering : Craft clear, concise, and contextually relevant prompts to guide transformer-based models towards generating desired outputs for specific tasks.

- Iterate on prompts to optimize model performance.

- Instruction-Based Prompting : Implement instruction-based prompting to guide the model toward achieving specific goals, ensuring that the outputs are contextually accurate and aligned with task objectives.

- Zero-shot, Few-shot, Many-shot Learning : Utilize zero-shot, few-shot, and many-shot learning techniques to improve model performance without the need for full retraining.

- Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Prompting : Implement Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting to guide models through complex reasoning tasks, ensuring that the outputs are logically structured and provide step-by-step explanations.

- Model Evaluation : Use evaluation metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE, and other relevant metrics to assess and improve the performance of models for various NLP tasks.

- Model Deployment : Support the deployment of trained models into production environments and integrate them into existing systems for real-time applications.

- Bias Awareness : Be aware of and mitigate issues related to bias, hallucinations, and knowledge cutoffs in LLMs, ensuring high-quality and reliable outputs.

- Collaboration : Collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineers, data scientists, and product managers to deliver efficient and scalable NLP solutions.

Must Have Skill :

- Overall 7 years with at least 5+ years of experience working with transformer-based models and NLP tasks, with a focus on text generation, summarization, question answering, classification, and similar tasks.

- Expertise in transformer models like GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer), BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers), T5 (Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer), RoBERTa, and similar models.

- Familiarity with model architectures, attention mechanisms, and self-attention layers that enable LLMs to generate human-like text.

- Experience in fine-tuning pre-trained models on domain-specific datasets for tasks such as text generation, summarization, question answering, classification, and translation.

- Familiarity with concepts like attention mechanisms, context windows, tokenization, and embedding layers.

- Awareness of biases, hallucinations, and knowledge cutoffs that can affect LLM performance and output quality.

- Expertise in crafting clear, concise, and contextually relevant prompts to guide LLMs towards generating desired outputs.

- Experience in instruction-based prompting.

- Use of zero-shot, few-shot, and many-shot learning techniques for maximizing model performance without retraining.

- Experience in iterating on prompts to refine outputs, test model performance, and ensure consistent results.

- Crafting prompt templates for repetitive tasks, ensuring prompts are adaptable to different contexts and inputs.

- Expertise in chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting to guide LLMs through complex reasoning tasks by encouraging step-by-step breakdowns.

- Proficiency in Python and experience with NLP libraries (e.g., Hugging Face, SpaCy, NLTK).

- Experience with transformer-based models (e.g., GPT, BERT, T5) for text generation tasks.

- Experience in training, fine-tuning, and deploying machine learning models in an NLP context.

- Understanding of model evaluation metrics (e.g., BLEU, ROUGE).

Qualification :

- Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written.

Digital Media & Analytics

title: Business Analytics Senior Analyst
description:
About Medical Economics
The Cigna International Health Medical Economics team s responsibility is to transform data into strategic insights that drive affordability and impact. By linking interventions to financial outcomes, it enables informed decision-making, supports return on investment analysis, and ensures initiatives align with organizational goals. Through collaboration and continuous performance tracking, Medical Economics maximizes value across the enterprise.
Job Summary
We are looking for a technically skilled professional with a strong eye for data visualization to take full ownership of performance dashboards, ensuring they deliver clear, engaging, and actionable insights. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in data visualization, dashboard design, and automation of processes.
Key Responsibilities
Build and maintain Qlik Sense dashboards to present monthly performance of affordability initiatives in a clear, engaging and user-friendly format.
Own the migration of Tableau Dashboards to Qlik Sense, ensuring continuity, effectiveness and usability.
Build a comprehensive health analytics dashboard that allows stakeholders across International markets to quickly identify opportunities for affordability savings.
Continuously monitor performance results to identify trends and proactively surface new areas for analysis to the broader team.
Drive optimization and automation of existing saving tracking processes to improve efficiency and accuracy.
Collaborate with members of the Medical Economics team and support on data analysis as required.
Required Skills & Qualification
Bachelors degree in data analytics, computer science or similar.
6+ years of experience in data analytics role, preferably medical insurance related.
Strong experience using Qlik Sense.
Advanced user of Microsoft Excel, Alteryx Designer / SAS enterprise, or similar.
Knowledge of SQL language or similar.
High level of numeracy, attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
Strong visualization skills with the ability to communicate technical insights through simple and strategic dashboards.
About The Cigna Group
Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

title: Principal Data Standards Analyst (Laboratory Expert)

The Principal Data Standards Analyst (Laboratory Expert) also provides specialized oversight on laboratory data handling, collaborating with internal teams and external central laboratories to mitigate risks related to biomarker, genomic, and flow cytometry data. This role is instrumental in managing laboratory data mapping, governance, and compliance to support regulatory submissions and clinical study execution .

Provide training and mentorship on laboratory test mapping processes and CDISC Standard Controlled Terminology (CT) implementation.

title: Data Science & Analytics Strategy
description:
WORK YOULL DO
As a Data Science Consultant/Senior Consultant within CS&D, you will deliver data-driven insights, actionable recommendations, and cutting-edge analytical solutions. Youll play a pivotal role in supporting clients commercial strategies with a blend of technical depth and strategic thinking.
1. Data Science & Analytics Strategy
Design and implement data strategies aligned to business goals across pricing, sales, marketing, and product development.
Integrate data science into cross-functional business workflows with teams from product, marketing, finance, and operations.
Develop predictive models, ML algorithms, and advanced statistical methodologies (e.g., XGBoost, Random Forest, SVM, hierarchical clustering, Lasso/Ridge regression).
Recommend best practices in data governance, quality, and integration.
Build customer segmentation and clustering frameworks for tailored marketing and product strategies.
2. Advanced Data Analysis & Market Intelligence
Conduct pricing and transaction-level analysis to identify optimization opportunities.
Build financial models to assess pricing strategies impact on revenue and profitability.
Track market trends, emerging technologies, and competitive benchmarks to inform client strategies.
Execute campaign analytics, market-mix modelling (MMM), and conjoint / product affinity analyses to guide customer engagement efforts.
3. Domain-Specific Data Solutions
Healthcare & Life Sciences: Predictive analytics for patient outcomes and clinical trial optimization.
Sales & Marketing: ML-powered dynamic pricing and campaign optimization.
Product Innovation: Data-driven decisioning in product design based on real-time customer insights.
Consumer & Retail: Demand forecasting, inventory optimization, and customer loyalty analytics.
Technology Sector: Predictive performance modeling and QA automation using AI.
4. Advanced Analytics & Model Development
Build and optimize ML models for classification, regression, clustering, and recommendation systems.
Use NLP and deep learning (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) to derive insights from unstructured data.
Maintain and recalibrate existing analytical models to ensure ongoing business relevance.
5. AI Engineering & Emerging Tech
Design AI solutions integrated with agentic platforms, LLMs, and orchestration pipelines for intelligent automation.
Apply concepts from AI engineering to productionize ML models and scale data pipelines using tools like Apache Spark, Hadoop, MLflow, and MLOps principles.
Utilize cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP) to deploy scalable AI solutions.
6. Stakeholder Engagement
Align pricing and data strategies with C-suite objectives through collaborative workshops and executive presentations.
Communicate complex analytical findings in business-friendly language.
Educate clients on data science tools and methods to foster internal capability-building.
7. Infrastructure & Technology Assessment
Evaluate clients' existing data and analytics maturity.
Recommend advanced data platforms and scalable architectures.
Lead deployment of new tools and ensure integration with enterprise systems.
8. Practice Development
Contribute to business development by leading proposal creation and solutioning for data science use cases.
Publish thought leadership, build proprietary toolkits, and mentor junior staff.
Act as a topic lead in data science, driving eminence and knowledge sharing across the firm.
KEY AREAS OF EXPERTISE
Customer Segmentation & Clustering
Market-Mix Modelling & Campaign Analytics
Price & Profit Optimization
Conjoint Analysis & Product Affinity Modeling
Machine Learning Algorithms: XGBoost, Random Forest, SVM, Time Series, Hierarchical Clustering, Ensemble Methods, Gradient Boosting
AI Engineering: Model Deployment, MLOps, Intelligent Agents, LLM Integration
Big Data: Apache Spark, Hadoop
Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP
Visualization Tools: Tableau, Power BI
REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS
Deloitte is seeking an Experienced Practitioner with deep expertise in Data Science and Technology, underpinned by strong analytical acumen, strategic consulting experience, and cross-industry exposure. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience in applying data science to drive customer-centric growth strategies, with a focus on pricing, segmentation, marketing effectiveness, and advanced analytics. This role sits within the Customer Strategy and Design team and plays a critical part in delivering impactful outcomes across global engagements.
Professional experience: Experience in strategy consulting from consulting firms, Big 4 firms, OR experience within pricing department in industry with a focus on pricing strategy, planning and technology.
Industry experience: across below listed industries is preferable:
Retail, Consumer Goods & Industrial Products
Telecom, Media & Technology
Life Sciences & Healthcare
Energy & Industrial
Transportation, Hospitality
Good understanding of how businesses price the products and services to different customers in a B2B or B2C or B2B2C environment.
Core Consulting skills: Managing the pace and delivery of projects including coordination with key project stakeholders, reporting key findings, and contributing to the wider business unit through business development, knowledge sharing and other activities.
Analytical skills: A strong technical foundation in building analytical solutions and experience with complex data sets, performing quantitative analysis (descriptive and prescriptive) and research (primary and secondary); synthesizing and presenting insights and recommendations from data.
Key Analytical Focus Areas:
Customer segmentation and clustering using demographic, behavioural, and transactional data
Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and campaign analytics to assess marketing effectiveness and ROI
Price and profit optimization models across products and segments
Conjoint analysis and product affinity modeling for innovation and customer preference alignment
Demand forecasting, dynamic pricing, and elasticity modeling
Expertise in Advanced ML & Statistical Methodologies:
Experience with techniques such as Random Forest, XGBoost, SVM, Gradient Boosting, Time Series Forecasting, Logistic Regression, K-Means Clustering, Hierarchical Clustering, Lasso/Ridge Regression, PCA, Survival Models, and Ensemble Methods
Familiarity with deep learning models for NLP, image analysis, and unstructured data processing
AI Engineering & Emerging Platforms:
Exposure to AI engineering principles for scalable model deployment using CI/CD and MLOps pipelines
Hands-on experience or understanding of agentic platforms, LLM-based orchestration, or intelligent agent frameworks for task automation and knowledge management
Working knowledge of integrating ML solutions into production environments and performance optimization
Mandatory Tools Experience:
Microsoft Office: Proficient in Microsoft Excel for advanced data analysis and financial modeling, and Microsoft PowerPoint for creating impactful presentations and visualizing data insights
Python/R: Proficiency in Python or R for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and machine learning
SQL: Strong command over SQL for data querying and management
Tableau/Power BI: Experience in data visualization using Tableau or Power BI to communicate insights effectively
Preferred Tools Experience:
Apache Spark/Hadoop: Familiarity with big data frameworks like Spark or Hadoop for handling large datasets
TensorFlow/PyTorch: Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch for advanced analytical models
AWS/Azure/GCP: Knowledge of cloud services (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for deploying scalable data science solutions
SAS: Experience with SAS for advanced analytics, particularly in sectors like healthcare or finance

Masters in Statistics, Data Science, etc.
MBA from Tier 1 B School or Abroad / Masters in Economics with specialization in Data Science
4 - 6 years for Senior Consultants
2 - 3 years for Consultants

title: Quality Analyst
description:
The Quality Analyst role in International Banking Operations is essential for maintaining control, ensuring regulatory compliance, and driving process excellence across global transaction processing.
Here is a comprehensive Job Description (JD) for an International Banking Operations Quality Analyst (QA).
International Banking Operations Quality Analyst
Location: [City, Country] Department: Operations Risk & Control / Quality Assurance Reports To: Quality Assurance Manager / Head of Operations
Job Summary
The International Banking Operations Quality Analyst is responsible for conducting continuous quality assurance audits on core operational processes, including international payments, trade finance, and customer static data management. The primary function is to verify adherence to internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and mandatory regulatory controls (AML, KYC), identify process defects, analyze error trends, and recommend corrective actions to mitigate operational and financial risk in the bank's international activities.
Key Responsibilities
1. Quality Assurance and Auditing
Execute QA Checks: Perform rigorous Quality Control (QC) and Quality Assurance (QA) checks on a statistically relevant sample of complex international transactions, specifically focusing on:
International Payments: Reviewing SWIFT messages (MT103, MT202, etc.), payment routing, cover matching, and cut-off adherence.
Trade Finance: Verifying document compliance for Letters of Credit (LCs) and collections against UCP 600, ISBP, and trade finance policies.
Customer Lifecycle: Auditing new account opening (Day 2 Checks) and static data amendments to verify KYC/AML documentation completeness and accuracy.
Error Identification and Categorization: Accurately identify, classify, and record errors (e.g., policy breach, control failure, process gap, system error) using the bank's designated quality assurance platform.
Documentation: Maintain comprehensive and audit-ready documentation for all QA reviews conducted, findings, and subsequent corrective actions taken.
2. Risk and Compliance Monitoring
Control Verification: Ensure that all operational activities comply with both internal control standards and external regulatory mandates (e.g., AML, OFAC, Sanctions, FATCA).
Risk Escalation: Determine the risk level associated with identified process deviations and transaction errors, promptly escalating critical or high-risk findings (e.g., potential sanctions breaches) to the Compliance and Risk Management teams.
Policy Governance: Collaborate with the Governance and Procedures teams to review and update SOPs, checklists, and process flows based on error trends and regulatory changes.
3. Reporting and Continuous Improvement
Data Analysis: Conduct detailed statistical analysis of QA data to identify systemic error root causes, recurring control weaknesses, and performance bottlenecks across various operational teams and jurisdictions.
Management Information System (MIS): Prepare and present insightful quality dashboards and reports for Operations Management and Senior Stakeholders, highlighting quality scores, error rates, and risk exposures.
Feedback and Training: Provide clear, constructive, and actionable feedback to Operations Officers, Team Leaders, and the Training department to address individual and team knowledge gaps and drive quality improvement initiatives.
Process Enhancement: Act as a catalyst for change by suggesting specific, data-driven process enhancements, technology improvements, or automation opportunities to reduce manual errors and improve Straight Through Processing (STP) rates.
Qualifications
Education and Experience
Bachelors degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 3+ years of experience in International Banking Operations, specifically in Payments, Trade Finance, or Reconciliation.
Minimum of 1+ years of experience in a dedicated Quality Assurance, Internal Control, or Audit-related role within the financial sector.
Required Skills and Knowledge
Technical Operations Expertise: In-depth working knowledge of SWIFT messaging (MT/MX), cross-border payment investigations, and international settlement mechanics.
Regulatory Knowledge: Strong practical understanding of KYC/AML requirements and global sanctions (e.g., OFAC) as applied to banking transactions.
Analytical Skills: Proven ability to analyze large sets of transactional data, identify trends, and use quality tools (e.g., Excel, BI tools) to generate conclusive reports.
Attention to Detail: Exceptional meticulousness and a keen eye for detail are critical for identifying complex document discrepancies and data input errors.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for documenting findings, providing coaching feedback, and presenting reports to senior management.
Certifications (Preferred): Certification in a relevant area, such as Six Sigma, Certified Documentary Credit Specialist (CDCS), or Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS).

  The Responsible Business team at the Thomson Reuters Foundation works to promote corporate transparency and ethical business practices that support more equitable economies. By leveraging TRF s global networks, legal expertise, and data intelligence, the team collaborates with businesses, investors, lawyers, civil society organisations, and journalists to explore how business decisions impact lives and livelihoods.

Their work spans a range of critical issues, including:
Labour rights and workforce transparency
Responsible adoption of AI technologies
The just transition to a greener economy

The team also hosts cross-sector working groups, data-driven briefings, and training sessions, and plays a central role in TRF s annual Trust Conference, which convenes global leaders to discuss pressing human rights and business issues.

Responsible AI



Centre of Excellence (COE) within Accenture to join our multi-disciplinary Responsible AI team. We are committed to help people build AI products/solutions/services in a responsible and trustworthy manner.

Fairness/Bias, Explainability, Model Validation and Robustness, to assess model behaviour through a Responsibility lens.

Collaborate with colleagues to develop best practices, frameworks, tools for scalable implementation of Responsible AI in enterprises

Strong in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboard design, performance tuning).
Hands-on in data wrangling: merging, unpivoting, deduplication, error handling.
Proven ability to manage refresh strategies and keep reports accurate, up to date.

title: Bill of Material (BOM) Analyst
description:
The Bill of Material (BOM) Analyst is a critical role responsible for the creation, maintenance, and accuracy of Bills of Material for new product launches and ongoing product changes. This position plays a pivotal part in ensuring product data integrity throughout the entire product lifecycle, from concept to end-of-life. The BOM Analyst will collaborate extensively with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality and accurate BOMs, and will actively work on process optimization and improvement initiatives to ensure effective resource utilization and maximum system efficiency. This role directly contributes to streamlined manufacturing, cost control, and the delivery of high-quality products.
Education: A Bachelors or Masters degree in an engineering discipline, supply chain management or business administration, is preferred.
Experience: Typically 0-5+ years of experience in BOM management, inventory management, or a related data field, particularly within the automotive industry.
Technical Proficiency: Strong proficiency in PLM and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Windchill) is crucial. Familiarity with data analysis tools like Microsoft Excel, Business Objects, and Access is also beneficial.
Analytical Abilities: Excellent attention to detail, strong analytical, and problem-solving skills are essential for interpreting engineering drawings, specifications, and complex data.
Communication and Collaboration: Strong communication and collaboration skills are required to interact effectively with various internal and external stakeholders.
Other: Knowledge of manufacturing processes and materials, experience with change management processes, and a proactive, results-driven mindset are highly valued.
1. BOM Management: Create, maintain, and analyze Bills of Materials in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems. This includes ensuring all components, Product hierarchy/structure, and specifications are accurately documented and updated.
2. Structure Development: Develop and maintain comprehensive BOMs that detail components, materials, assemblies, and sub-assemblies, including phantom BOMs and modular BOMs, as required by product complexity.
3. Data Accuracy and Compliance: Responsible for the accuracy and timeliness of information within systems, performing verification of launch BOM accuracy, and establishing BOM review process for pre-production builds. Ensure compliance with company standards and process guidelines.
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, Purchasing, production, and supply chain teams to track changes, resolve discrepancies, and optimize BOM coding.
5. Lead BOM review meetings with cross-functional teams for resolution of open issues and participate in engineering change and launch reviews.
6. Change Management: Manage engineering change orders and update BOMs accordingly. Assist in coordinating engineering/process changes and minimizing obsolete materials.
7. Inventory and Material Optimization: Support engineering and inventory control by leading efforts to maintain and improve inventory accuracy.
8. Support Cost reduction initiatives - Identify cost-saving opportunities through BOM data analysis.
9. System and Process Improvement: Work closely with IT and system administrators to suggest enhancements to PLM/ERP systems to improve BOM data management, reporting, and user experience.
10. Best Practices: Research and implement industry best practices for BOM management, configuration control, and product data governance to drive continuous improvement.
11. New Product Introduction Support: Support new product introductions by developing initial BOMs, BOM scrubbing , validation process etc
12. Training and Guidance: Develop a deep understanding of systems and processes, providing direction and training to colleagues

title: Compensation Analyst, Global Consulting CoE
description:
This role provides comprehensive support to a Sr. Compensation Consultant within the Global CoE and requires strong analytical skills, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, contributing to efficient and accurate compensation processes. The analyst will conduct job evaluations and data analysis within a compensation function.
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Compensation Consultant Support: Provide day-to-day support to assigned compensation consultants, gathering data and creating outputs for regular routines (HR Business Partner update meetings, etc.) and annual processes (Annual Performance & Rewards (APR), Annual and Ad Hoc Competitive Reviews, People & Organization Review, etc.). Support or lead special projects as needed, contributing to business-led compensation initiatives and maintaining job architecture.
Job Evaluations: Conduct job evaluations using established methodologies to determine the relative worth of different jobs within the organization. Manage the intake of job evaluation requests (via ServiceNow tickets) and ensure case closure and accurate system updates (MarketPay, etc.) following the evaluation process.
Market Analysis: Conduct market analysis to ensure the companys compensation remains competitive. This includes identifying appropriate survey sources, collecting and analyzing data, and preparing reports summarizing findings.
Data Analysis and Reporting: Analyze compensation data to identify trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement. Prepare regular reports and presentations summarizing compensation data and providing recommendations.
Compensation Modeling: Develop and maintain compensation models to forecast compensation costs and analyze the impact of various compensation strategies.
Compliance: Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations related to compensation.
Project Management: Manage various compensation-related projects, such as implementing new compensation programs or updating existing ones.
Key Partners:
Global Compensation Consultants
International Total Rewards Consultant
Key Objectives:
Provide comprehensive data analysis and draft final product decks/analysis to free up consultant capacity for strategic planning and business consultation.
Ensure clear and consistent compensation analysis that supports business and talent strategies.
Provide analysis for job evaluations and present findings to the compensation consultant for finalization.
Ensure systems accurately reflect job evaluation outcomes (job profiles, MarketPay matching).
Maintain clear job evaluation tracking and meet job evaluation Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelors degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
5-7 years of experience in compensation or a related field (experience with job evaluations preferred).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other data analysis tools.
Experience with compensation systems (MarketPay experience preferred).
Excellent organizational and time management skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Dataiku
description:
About the Job :

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in driving our data engineering initiatives, with a strong emphasis on leveraging Dataiku's capabilities to enhance data processing and analytics. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing robust data pipelines, ensuring seamless integration of diverse data sources, and maintaining high data quality and accessibility to support our business intelligence and advanced analytics projects.

This role requires a unique blend of expertise in traditional data engineering principles, advanced data modeling, and a forward-thinking approach to integrating cutting-AI technologies, particularly LLM Mesh for Generative AI applications. If you are passionate about building scalable data solutions and are eager to explore the cutting edge of AI, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities :

- Dataiku Leadership : Drive data engineering initiatives with a strong emphasis on leveraging Dataiku capabilities for data preparation, analysis, visualization, and the deployment of data solutions.

- Data Pipeline Development : Design, develop, and optimize robust and scalable data pipelines to support various business intelligence and advanced analytics projects. This includes developing and maintaining ETL/ELT processes to automate data extraction, transformation, and loading from diverse sources.

- Data Modeling & Architecture : Apply expertise in data modeling techniques to design efficient and scalable database structures, ensuring data integrity and optimal performance.

- ETL/ELT Expertise : Implement and manage ETL processes and tools to ensure efficient and reliable data flow, maintaining high data quality and accessibility.

- Gen AI Integration : Explore and implement solutions leveraging LLM Mesh for Generative AI applications, contributing to the development of innovative AI-powered features.

- Programming & Scripting : Utilize programming languages such as Python and SQL for data manipulation, analysis, automation, and the development of custom data solutions.

- Cloud Platform Deployment : Deploy and manage scalable data solutions on cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, leveraging their respective services for optimal performance and cost-efficiency.

- Data Quality & Governance : Ensure seamless integration of data sources, maintaining high data quality, consistency, and accessibility across all data assets. Implement data governance best practices.

- Collaboration & Mentorship : Collaborate closely with data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver impactful solutions. Potentially mentor junior team members.

- Performance Optimization : Continuously monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines and data systems.

Required Skills & Experience :

- Proficiency in Dataiku : Demonstrable expertise in Dataiku for data preparation, analysis, visualization, and building end-to-end data pipelines and applications.

- Expertise in Data Modeling : Strong understanding and practical experience in various data modeling techniques (e.g., dimensional modeling, Kimball, Inmon) to design efficient and scalable database structures.

- ETL/ELT Processes & Tools : Extensive experience with ETL/ELT processes and a proven track record of using various ETL tools (e.g., Dataiku's built-in capabilities, Apache Airflow, Talend, SSIS, etc.).

- Familiarity with LLM Mesh : Familiarity with LLM Mesh or similar frameworks for Gen AI applications, understanding its concepts and potential for integration.

- Programming Languages : Strong proficiency in Python for data manipulation, scripting, and developing data solutions. Solid command of SQL for complex querying, data analysis, and database interactions.

- Cloud Platforms : Knowledge and hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS or Azure) for deploying and managing scalable data solutions (e.g., S3, EC2, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, etc.).

- Gen AI Concepts : Basic understanding of Generative AI concepts and their potential applications in data engineering.

- Problem-Solving : Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen eye for detail.

- Communication : Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Bonus Points (Nice to Have) :

- Experience with other big data technologies (e.g., Spark, Hadoop, Snowflake).

- Familiarity with data governance and data security best practices.

- Experience with MLOps principles and tools.

- Contributions to open-source projects related to data engineering or AI.

Education :
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

description:

To lead, manage, and enhance the efficiency, quality, and patient experience of the Outpatient Department (OPD) through effective operational planning, team leadership, and process excellence in alignment with hospital standards.

Maintain proper documentation, records, and reports for internal and external audits.
Drive quality improvement projects within the OPD setup.

Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports related to OPD operations, footfall, revenue, and feedback.
